text.p: Unilever NV/Plc said it had strengthened its position in Mexico through an ice cream joint venture, the acquisition of rights to a leading margarine brand and a distribution deal for its Anderson Clayton food division.
It did not disclose financial terms of the three deals.
Unilever said the joint venture with Helados Holanda, Bing and Friser would generate annual sales of 128 million guilders and was its first move into the Mexican ice cream market.
It said it had also acquired rights to the Iberia margeria brand, which has annual sales of about 36 million guilders, from the Prolesa group.
Unilever said it had also struck a distribution deal with Prolesa for its existing Anderson Clayton foods business in Mexico.
Unilever said its Unilever de Mexico unit had annual sales of over 735 million guilders.
